name: Crack Bang Boom
blurb: An annual international comics festival in Rosario since 2010, awarding the Trillo Prize to Argentine comic creators alongside a cosplay contest.
notes: The 15th edition (XV) already ran Aug 13-16, 2026 (confirmed by the site's own text - Premios Trillo eligibility 'ediciones anteriores de 2010 a 2025' plus matching news coverage: rosariotimes.com and conclusion.com.ar both report Crack Bang Boom 2026 ran Aug 13-16 at the CEC/Galpon 11/Puerto Joven/Tecnoteca in Rosario, with the Trillo Prize ceremony Aug 15 and the cosplay contest Aug 16). That's before this window (ends 2026-10-05), and the live site still shows that edition's registration copy without having posted a 2027 date yet, so editions is empty and the Aug 2026 show is recorded as 'last'. No distinct organizer company name is stated on-site (only 'la organizacion de Crack Bang Boom').
